[!dolt] skip
# Test bd delete preview and force delete
bd init --prefix test --quiet
bd create 'Issue to delete' --description 'Delete me' --json
extractid ISSUE

bd delete $ISSUE --dry-run
stdout 'DELETE PREVIEW'
stdout 'Would delete: 1 issue'

bd delete $ISSUE --force
stdout 'Deleted'

! bd show $ISSUE
stderr 'not found|no issues found|Issue .* not found'
